classification: MEASURED/CALCULATED: CALCULATED ONLY; conditional sensitivity, not measured or safety bounds
threshold_floor_expression: normal_high * detector_max / detector_min; excludes divider, ripple and timing
energy_expression: 0.5 * L * I^2, constant unsaturated L only
limitations: Normal high, bias/temperature C, constant L, delay and fault profile are incomplete bounds.
C is a raw-side bank; after disconnect it cannot be assumed to support the load.
Inductor energy after interruption stresses raw capacitance and switch/clamps; it is not all load let-through.
Input eFuse limiting cannot be assumed instantaneous.
